song: 30 - Daft Punk - Around the World (Official Audio)
title: acid sweep, the kick builds the shake
story: Around the World is a one-bar loop of vocal and bass over four-on-the-floor, eighths on the hats. The pre-roll lights the curtains in a left-to-right sweep that restarts each bar; the build tightens the shake on every kick, bar by bar, while the brightness climbs; the drop at 6879 and 6903 releases the shake and lands impacto and a hue step; after it every kick punches and the sweep continues brighter, the emphasis flashing on each off-beat eighth.
